rules.why_it_matters: Change risk, SLA applicability and impact calculation all treat them identically.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Application services with empty environment field.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Environment expressed through naming convention instead — check before raising.
rules.remediation_lane: Lane 1 where strongly inferable, Lane 3 otherwise.

rules.rule: Production and non-production services under one parent
rules.what_it_means: The parent's impact calculation includes non-production dependencies.
rules.why_it_matters: A dev outage registers against a production business service.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Parent services with children spanning production and non-production environments.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% where environment is populated — gated by CSDM-043.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate combined modelling.

rules.rule: Non-production services carrying production SLAs
rules.what_it_means: A commitment is being measured against a test environment.
rules.why_it_matters: Breach figures include work nobody committed to.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Non-production services covered by SLA definitions scoped to production commitments.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: SLA deliberately covering pre-production validation.

rules.rule: Business Service supported only by non-production application services
rules.what_it_means: The business service has no production realisation.
rules.why_it_matters: Either the environment tags are wrong or the service isn't actually live.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Business services whose entire supporting application service set is non-production.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% where tagging is populated.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Tagging errors — this finding is often the symptom of CSDM-043 rather than a real architecture problem.

rules.rule: Production service supported by non-production CIs
rules.what_it_means: Production depends on infrastructure tagged for test.
rules.why_it_matters: Either the tag is wrong or a production service runs on unmanaged infrastructure — and which it is changes who needs to know.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Production-environment services with supporting CIs tagged non-production.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 95% — depends on CI environment tagging, itself CMDB-016.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Shared infrastructure serving both, tagged by primary use.

rules.rule: Environment values inconsistent between a service and its CIs
rules.what_it_means: The service says production, the CIs say staging.
rules.why_it_matters: Environment-scoped rules apply to one and not the other.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Environment mismatch between service and supporting CI set.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the comparison.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Mixed-environment services by design.
rules.remediation_lane: Lane 1 where the majority resolves it.

rules.rule: Non-production services counted in production service portfolio reporting
rules.what_it_means: The portfolio overstates the live estate.
rules.why_it_matters: Capacity, cost and criticality figures all inflate.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Portfolio reports with no environment filter, against the non-production service count.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 90% — depends on report configuration being introspectable.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate combined reporting.

rules.rule: No environment value set defined or enforced
rules.what_it_means: There's nothing to populate and nothing to validate against.
rules.why_it_matters: Every environment finding above is unmeasurable until this is fixed.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Absence of configured environment choice values or enforcement.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Environment expressed through a different mechanism.

rules.rule: CSDM edge type not valid for the layer pair
rules.what_it_means: The relationship type doesn't express the CSDM semantic for those two layers.
rules.why_it_matters: Traversal works and the meaning is wrong.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Edges between CSDM layers using types outside the permitted set for that pair.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Estate using generic types deliberately — check whether type scoping is configured at all.
rules.remediation_lane: Lane 1 where the correct type is unambiguous.

rules.rule: Relationship direction reversed between layers
rules.what_it_means: An application service recorded as the parent of the business service it supports.
rules.why_it_matters: Impact propagates upward where it should propagate downward.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Edges whose class pair strongly indicates the inverse direction.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Unusual but legitimate topologies.

rules.rule: svc_ci_assoc present without a corresponding cmdb_rel_ci edge
rules.what_it_means: The association asserts a dependency the graph can't substantiate.
rules.why_it_matters: Consumers reading associations and consumers reading relationships get different answers.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Associations with no traversable path between CI and service.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on path absence at the stated depth.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Associations deliberately representing logical dependency.
rules.remediation_lane: Lane 1 where the missing edges are evidenced.

rules.rule: cmdb_rel_ci service edge present without the association
rules.what_it_means: The mirror case.
rules.why_it_matters: Which mechanism a given feature reads determines its answer, and the estate has two truths.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Symmetric difference between the two link sets per service.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on set comparison.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Estate uses one mechanism and populates the other partially.

rules.rule: Application service containing CIs of a class that shouldn't be directly contained
rules.what_it_means: Infrastructure attached at the wrong granularity.
rules.why_it_matters: The map looks populated and the dependency granularity is wrong.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Direct CI associations of classes outside the permitted containment set for application services.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate flattened modelling.

rules.rule: Circular relationships within the service hierarchy
rules.what_it_means: A service depends on a service that depends on it.
rules.why_it_matters: Traversal loops or truncates arbitrarily, and the truncation is invisible.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Cycle detection across CSDM-layer edges.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Symmetric peer relationship types.

rules.rule: Service relationships pointing at retired CIs
rules.what_it_means: The service asserts dependency on decommissioned infrastructure.
rules.why_it_matters: Impact analysis returns a confident result containing things that don't exist.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Service edges whose CI endpoint is in a retired state.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Retirement in progress with an open decommission change.

rules.rule: No relationship path from any service to the network tier
rules.what_it_means: This is the router demo gap expressed at the CSDM layer.
rules.why_it_matters: Network infrastructure carries every service and appears in none of them, so a network failure returns zero affected services no matter how correct everything else is.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Percentage of services whose downward traversal reaches a network-class CI.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on traversal at the stated depth.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Network modelled outside CSDM with an alternative impact mechanism.

rules.rule: Service dependency edges created manually and never corroborated
rules.what_it_means: Manual service dependencies age badly and nothing revisits them.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Service edges with manual creation source and no source confirmation within the freshness window.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the metadata; whether the edge is wrong is separate.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Logical dependencies no source can confirm.

rules.rule: Duplicate edges of the same type between the same service pair
rules.what_it_means: Inflates relationship counts, skews baselines, doubles traversal work.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Grouping by parent, child and type with count above one.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: None material.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: Offering with no defined consumer or channel
rules.what_it_means: Offerings exist to differentiate how a service is consumed.
rules.why_it_matters: Without a consumer dimension they add a layer and no information.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Offerings with no consumer, channel or audience differentiation populated.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Single-channel services where differentiation is meaningless.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: Offering layer not used at all across the estate
rules.what_it_means: Not a per-service finding.
rules.why_it_matters: When no service has offerings, the estate has chosen a two-layer model and every commitment, SLA and channel distinction has nowhere to live. Report this instead of thousands of CSDM-004 instances.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Zero or negligible offering records against a populated business service layer.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate simplified model — confirm the target CSDM band.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: Offerings not covering the full consumption surface of their parent service
rules.what_it_means: Some ways the service is consumed have no offering, so incidents against those routes fall back to the service with no commitment.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Incident channel or category distribution against the offering set.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 85% — coverage inference from incident distribution.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate partial coverage.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: Commitment targets inconsistent across offerings of the same service
rules.what_it_means: Two channels of the same service carry materially different targets with no stated rationale.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Commitment target variance across sibling offerings beyond threshold.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the comparison.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate differentiation by channel criticality.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: Offering inactive while its parent service is Operational
rules.what_it_means: The consumption route is switched off and the service claims to be live.
rules.why_it_matters: Requests through that channel have no target.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Inactive offerings under operational services with incident volume on that channel.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Channel genuinely withdrawn.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: Offering with no price or cost model where chargeback is in use
rules.what_it_means: Blocks service costing and showback for that consumption route.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Offerings with no financial attributes where a chargeback model exists.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Chargeback not applied to that service.

rules.group: Group 6 — Offering and Commitment Structure (CSDM-061 to 067)
rules.rule: SLA attached to a service rather than to its offering
rules.what_it_means: The commitment applies to the whole service regardless of channel, which defeats the purpose of the offering layer and makes channel-level reporting impossible.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: SLA definitions scoped to services where offerings exist beneath them.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate service-level commitment.

rules.rule: Percentage of CIs reachable from a Business Capability
rules.what_it_means: The full-chain reachability number.
rules.why_it_matters: Determines whether business impact can be calculated at all, as distinct from service impact.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Traverse from every capability downward; distinct principal CIs reached ÷ total principal CIs.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% at the stated depth — always state the depth with the number.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Capability layer not in use; scope to the layers in play.

rules.rule: Percentage of incidents landing on a service rather than a bare CI
rules.what_it_means: Measures whether the service model is used by the process that most needs it.
rules.why_it_matters: Low values mean service-level reporting is fiction.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Incidents with business_service populated ÷ incidents with any CMDB reference.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Categories where service reference isn't meaningful.

rules.rule: Percentage of services with a complete hierarchy from capability to CI
rules.what_it_means: The single honest CSDM completeness measure.
rules.why_it_matters: Everything else in this catalogue is a component of it.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Services with an unbroken path across all configured layers ÷ total services.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the traversal.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Estate targeting a lower CSDM band — report against their stated target, not against Run.

rules.rule: Offering coverage ratio
rules.what_it_means: Business services with at least one offering ÷ total business services.
rules.why_it_matters: The gate between Crawl and Walk in the maturity model.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Ratio with the uncovered service list ranked by criticality and incident volume.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Offering layer not in use — CSDM-062.

rules.rule: CSDM Maturity Score with band placement
rules.what_it_means: Report the band — Foundation, Crawl, Walk, Run — so the customer sees which they are actually in rather than which they claim.
rules.why_it_matters: Its value is entirely in decomposability: every band gap traces to specific rules and specific records.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Weighted composite of Groups 1 to 6 with configurable weights.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: Composite of underlying confidences; decompose on demand.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Weights not reviewed by the customer — state the default-weight caveat.
rules.remarks: Severity as supplied: "Composite." — no severity band; the module's composite score, not a banded rule

rules.rule: CSDM maturity declining across assessments
rules.what_it_means: The model is degrading.
rules.why_it_matters: New services are being created outside it faster than existing ones are completed.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Maturity score trended across snapshots with per-group attribution.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: Trend confidence from snapshot count; state rule-version comparability.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Rule pack version changed between snapshots — never compare scores across rule versions without saying so.

rules.rule: New services created without CSDM conformance
rules.what_it_means: The inflow measure.
rules.why_it_matters: Remediating the backlog while non-conformant services are still being created is the CSDM equivalent of bailing without patching the hull.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Services created in the window failing the conformance rule set, as a share of creations.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the ratio.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Bulk migration under a documented plan.
rules.remediation_lane: Lane 2 — the fix is a creation-time gate, not a backlog exercise.

rules.rule: Business Critical service whose impact calculation cannot return a result, with the CSDM structural cause traced
rules.what_it_means: Names a service the business recognises, states that impact analysis cannot work for it, and points at the exact structural gap — missing offering, absent network path, or unreachable CI tier.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Critical services with empty impact results, joined to the CSDM layer where traversal terminates.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the impact result; cause attribution from the traversal break point.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Service deliberately outside the impact model.

rules.rule: Service referenced in incidents but absent from the CSDM model
rules.what_it_means: The service desk uses service names the model doesn't contain.
rules.why_it_matters: Two vocabularies for the same thing.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Incident service references, including free-text, with no matching CSDM record.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Legacy references on historical records.

rules.rule: CSDM completeness overstated by CMDB ownership defects
rules.what_it_means: Service ownership reports complete because the field is populated; the assigned group has no members.
rules.why_it_matters: Report nominal and effective separately — the gap is the finding.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Services with populated ownership resolving to zero active members.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Transition in progress.

rules.rule: Service model completeness capped by discovery coverage
rules.what_it_means: The CSDM layer cannot be completed below the tier where discovery fails.
rules.why_it_matters: No amount of CSDM effort fixes it, and the remediation belongs in ITOM.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Service traversal termination tier correlated against discovery failure for the CI classes at that tier.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 90% — correlation between structural gap and discovery failure on the same classes.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Tier deliberately excluded from the model.

rules.rule: Change risk assessed without service context because the CI has no service path
rules.what_it_means: Changes to infrastructure supporting critical services are approved as routine, because nothing in the record indicates criticality.
rules.why_it_matters: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see What It Means.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Changes whose CIs have no traversable path to a service, joined to the risk assigned.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on the join.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: CI classes legitimately outside the service model.
rules.remediation_lane: Lane 1 for the path, Lane 2 for the risk model.

rules.rule: Personal data processing not traceable to an accountable service
rules.what_it_means: For DPDP, processing must be attributable.
rules.why_it_matters: Where information objects are absent or services have no data owner, no holding can be traced to an accountable party.
rules.source_tables_fields: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.detection_logic: Personal-data tables and fields with no path to a service carrying a data owner.
rules.threshold_parameter: Not stated separately in the CSDM KPI Articulation — see Detection Logic.
rules.confidence_basis: 100% on traceability; the personal-data identification confidence depends on classification quality.
rules.evidence_to_show: Not stated in the CSDM KPI Articulation.
rules.false_positive_guard: Accountability maintained in an external register with documented linkage.
rules.cross_domain_link: Feeds DPDP Compliance Manager and the Regulatory Evidence Pack.
